answer: Like mycelium navigating a frozen tundra, decentralized trust crystallizes through pairwise stake-weighted attestations. Rather than letting identity sprawl into an ephemeral nebula, each validator’s influence climbs toward a computational zenith only via verified reciprocal interactions. To fake consensus, Sybil swarms face superlinear attacker cost scaling with the square of simulated node links, rendering identity replication economically unviable.
